options swap_delay=12 iteration=20 ignore_burst_energy=true;

klee char lvl=90/90 cons=6 talent=9,9,9;
klee add weapon="thewidsith" refine=5 lvl=90/90;
klee add set="crimsonwitchofflames" count=4;

diona char lvl=90/90 cons=1 talent=9,9,9;
diona add weapon="favoniuswarbow" refine=1 lvl=90/90;
diona add set="emblemofseveredfate" count=4;

furina char lvl=90/90 cons=4 talent=9,9,9;
furina add weapon="festeringdesire" refine=5 lvl=90/90;
furina add set="goldentroupe" count=4;

barbara char lvl=90/90 cons=1 talent=9,9,9;
barbara add weapon="prototypeamber" refine=5 lvl=90/90;
barbara add set="emblemofseveredfate" count=4;

target lvl=100 resist=0.1 radius=2 pos=0,2.4 hp=999999999;

active furina;
for let i = 0; i < 3; i = i + 1 {
  furina skill, burst;
  diona skill, burst;
  barbara skill;
  klee burst, attack:10;
  wait(400);
}
